summary: Verified the rewards bug fix (GET /api/rewards/eligible 42703 Postgres error) and the new persistent 'Your Rewards' Dashboard section. Backend: 17/17 pytest cases passed in test_rewards.py, including the new regression test test_admin_module1_reward_eligible_bugfix which confirms the admin (info@valuevade.com) — who has module 1 completed — now receives eligible=true for the 'Portfolio Templates' reward with trigger_ref_id=fintech-mvp-38 (previously this endpoint 500'd due to user_modules?user_id=eq... 42703 error). Frontend: logged in as the admin, navigated to /dashboard, section [data-testid=dashboard-rewards-section] appeared within ~3s (well under the noted 10s SLA), rendered exactly one RewardCard for 'Portfolio Templates' with the Share on LinkedIn button, YOUR LINKEDIN POST URL input, and 'I've shared — unlock my resource' CTA (correctly disabled until a valid URL is pasted). Admin CRUD gating and reward create/list/upload regressions all still pass.
critical_code_review_comments: MyRewardsSection swallows non-2xx responses with `if (!res.ok) return;` and empty catch — a future backend outage would silently show nothing again (same failure mode as the original bug). Suggest at least a console.warn or a small non-blocking error state so future regressions are noticed sooner.

wave_endpoints.py rewards_eligible: the module_ref_ids and capstone_ref_ids Postgrest `in.(...)` clauses interpolate reward-supplied UUIDs directly into the URL. UUIDs are validated by Supabase downstream, but if trigger_ref_id ever becomes free-form (e.g. slugs) this would be an injection surface — worth Pydantic-validating as UUID in the admin create path.

wave_endpoints.py is 3987 lines — should be split by feature area per the >700 line guideline. Not blocking, but the rewards logic (~600 lines) is a good candidate to extract into rewards_endpoints.py.
